name: Luca Salvadori
original_name: ルカ・サルヴァドーリ
source:
A TV cameraman for a news channel called Canale Zero.

Since he recently became Rebecca’s assistant, he’s the unlucky young man who'd to jump headfirst into the world of journalistic investigation.

Since he has a timid and less assertive personality, he can't stand up to Rebecca.

Hometown: Italy
